name: Stay The Night
source:
Stay The Night is a short Visual Novel about getting lost in the woods, meeting a ranger, and getting to know her as you spend the night in her cabin. Perhaps you'll make a new and cherished friend, but be careful what you say.

[From [url=https://emeraldtechnopath.itch.io/stay-the-night]itch.io[/url]]
